Battle Aces.reason: Development ended; do not advertise as an available recommendation.

Armor Clash 4.reason: No exact published identity confirmed. Not silently replaced with another game.

Rise of Legends.reason: No current official digital edition confirmed. Do not link an unrelated title or unofficial download.

Warfare Incorporated.reason: Non-Steam project requires a separate current desktop distribution and media check.

external.name: Beyond All Reason
external.why: The strongest free large-army detour: sprawling land, air and naval warfare, economies worth raiding, and enormous cooperative battles. More Total Annihilation than Zero Hour.
external.requirements: Standalone free game. Alpha software; use the official launcher.

external.name: OpenRA
external.why: Classic Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn and Dune 2000 reimagined with modern controls. One shared project, not three inflated duplicate recommendations.
external.requirements: Standalone open-source engine and included game mods. The installer explains any original-media options.

external.name: OpenHV
external.why: A compact, free sci-fi RTS with clear pixel art and a genuinely different economy. A useful obscure pick rather than another commercial C&C clone.
external.requirements: Standalone, open-source game.

external.name: Command & Conquer: Combined Arms
external.why: A modernized C&C crossover with mixed-era armies, campaigns, and skirmish depth. Particularly good when you want more C&C rather than a distant genre cousin.
external.requirements: Standalone OpenRA-based game; the original commercial C&C games are not required.

external.name: The Dawn of the Tiberium Age
external.why: Brings the first C&C and Red Alert armies together with a substantial single-player and co-op mission library. A particularly strong free skirmish-and-campaign choice.
external.requirements: Standalone; the original Tiberian Sun game is not required.

external.name: Twisted Insurrection
external.why: An alternative-history Tiberian Sun world with rebuilt factions, a large campaign, and excellent atmosphere. Best for a fresh C&C setting.
external.requirements: Standalone Tiberian Sun total conversion.

external.name: Contra X
external.why: Keep the Zero Hour foundation and turn the faction identities, challenge and super-powered arsenals up dramatically. Especially relevant to your existing Contra play.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour. Use the base-game and patch requirements specified for the exact Contra release; a standalone mod package is not a free base-game license.

external.name: Rise of the Reds
external.why: Adds Russia and the European Continental Alliance while rebuilding the original armies. A major upgrade for asymmetrical Zero Hour skirmishes.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour.

external.name: C&C: ShockWave
external.why: The most natural more-of-Zero-Hour recommendation: more distinctive generals, new arsenals, and familiar base building without discarding the original game's character.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour.

external.name: The End of Days
external.why: A modern-military reinterpretation of Zero Hour with Russia and expanded faction specializations. More grounded equipment than the original's most fantastical weapons.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour. This is the RTS mod, not the unrelated survival game with the same title.

external.name: Command & Conquer: Generals Evolution
external.why: Generals-style armies rebuilt in Red Alert 3's engine. A visual and mechanical reinterpretation rather than a native Zero Hour patch.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3, NOT Generals or Zero Hour.

external.name: Mental Omega
external.why: A huge Red Alert 2 expansion with deep faction asymmetry and a sprawling alternate campaign. One of the best ways to make a classic C&C feel enormous again.
external.requirements: Requires Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 and Yuri's Revenge.

external.name: 0 A.D.
external.why: A completely free ancient-warfare RTS with economies, construction and distinct civilizations. An Age of Empires-style detour, not a modern-military substitute.
external.requirements: Standalone open-source game.

external.name: StarCraft II
external.why: A benchmark for responsive controls and three genuinely asymmetric armies. Extensive campaign, co-op and custom-map options offer much more than competitive ladder play.
external.requirements: Battle.net. Free core access does not include every paid campaign or co-op commander.

external.name: StarCraft: Remastered
external.why: The classic three-faction RTS with a modern presentation option. More demanding unit management than Zero Hour, but exceptional campaign and skirmish history.
external.requirements: Battle.net. Remastered graphics are a paid edition; classic StarCraft access is a distinct offering.

external.name: Warcraft III: Reforged
external.why: Hero-led base building, four armies, campaigns and an enormous custom-game heritage. A fantasy alternative with smaller, more micro-intensive armies.
external.requirements: Battle.net. Check current edition reviews and custom-map compatibility before buying.

external.name: Warcraft I: Remastered
external.why: A historical look at the earliest Warcraft base-building loop with modernized controls. A nostalgia pick rather than a substitute for a feature-rich modern RTS.
external.requirements: Battle.net; paid remaster.

external.name: Warcraft II: Remastered
external.why: Orcs, humans, ships and classic tech trees with a refreshed presentation. Best approached as a classic remaster rather than a newly designed RTS.
external.requirements: Battle.net; paid remaster.

external.name: Empires: Dawn of the Modern World
external.why: Distinct civilizations across historical eras, with base building and land, naval and air armies. Particularly interesting when you want warfare beyond a single era.
external.requirements: Paid GOG edition. Multiplayer is not supported by this distribution; treat it primarily as a single-player classic.

external.name: World in Conflict: Complete Edition
external.why: Spectacular modern combined-arms battles and a memorable Cold War campaign. No conventional base-building economy: this is a tactical neighbor, not a Zero Hour clone.
external.requirements: Paid GOG edition. Original online services are discontinued; community multiplayer solutions are separate.

external.name: Warlords Battlecry II
external.why: Persistent heroes and varied fantasy races wrapped around proper RTS army building. A deep old-school hybrid, with compatibility caveats on newer systems.
external.requirements: GOG explicitly warns that Windows 10 and newer are not supported. Check compatibility before purchase.

external.name: Littlewargame
external.why: A surprisingly complete small-scale fantasy RTS running in a browser, with base building, custom maps and opponents without an installation.
external.requirements: Modern web browser.
